Installed **GBrain v0.60.734.0** keylessly, preserving your identity and existing instructions.

Verified with real GBrain calls: MCP `remember` → `recall`, recall after reopening the process, exact keyword search, correction, and withdrawal.

**Search choice:** conservative is active.

| Mode | Retrieval budget | Maximum chunks |

The guide’s illustrative cost matrix:

```text
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```

These are API examples, not subscription charges. Paid providers remain disabled. You can request another mode anytime.

Automatic fact saving and capture hooks are off. Free session upkeep and the local conversation archive are on; disable archiving with `gbrain transcripts archive off`.
